question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many customers live in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: Which countries have customers? List each country once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Give the genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums? Show artist name and album count.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY albums DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total sales amount for each country? Show country and total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY total DESC

question: How many tracks does the album 'Let There Be Rock' have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: What is the average track length in minutes, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM Track

question: How many invoices were issued in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2022'

question: Which customer spent the most money in total? Give their first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of playlists that contain more than 1000 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

question: Which sales support agent (employee) has the highest total sales from the customers they support? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which genre earned the most revenue from invoice lines? Give genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: Who are the top 3 artists by number of tracks sold (sum of quantity)? Show artist name and tracks sold.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was the total revenue per year? Show year and revenue in year order.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: How many customers have bought at least one track from the Jazz genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'
